title: Your First Recipe Goes Here
ingredients: Send me a photo of a recipe
method: Send a photo, screenshot, Instagram link, or typed recipe to this chat — I'll do the rest.
I'll extract the recipe, generate a matching image, and add it to your online recipe book.
You'll be able to search by ingredient, filter by tag, and find everything in one place.
notes: Every recipe gets a warm, editorial-style image generated just for it — so the whole book looks beautiful and consistent, no matter where the recipe came from.
